description: This file defines a class for validating nntp (Network News Transfer Protocol) URIs as part of the HTMLPurifier library, extending functionality from a base URI scheme class.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIScheme_nntp
classes.description: A class that validates and manages nntp URI scheme, specifying default port and validation behavior.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the given URI for the nntp scheme, nullifying userinfo and query components.
